sources.title: Cardinals' depth chart lists Tyler Allgeier as No. 1 RB, Jeremiyah Love as No. 2
sources.description: The Cardinals didn't draft running back Jeremiyah Love with the third overall pick so he could sit on the bench, but they're not going to declare him the starter just yet.
